notes: District latitude/longitude values are best-effort reference points, usually the main town or administrative centre, not official district boundary centroids.
Place latitude/longitude is included where reasonably identifiable; null means the place should be geocoded/verified before production use.
For official ward-level hierarchy, join this dataset to ZimSTATS/UNOCHA administrative boundaries. For additional localities, enrich with GeoNames/OpenStreetMap/RDC datasets.
